name: codex-project-memory
description: Talo keeps reviewed local project context available across AI agents with precise recall, unified review, and offline timelines.

interface.shortDescription: Never start over when you switch AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Talo keeps one private, reviewed project history available across Codex and other local AI agents. Recall only task-relevant knowledge within a clear token budget, inspect every registered project offline, and understand why work happened, its evidence, outputs, conclusions, and next steps.
defaultPrompt: Recall only the project memories relevant to this task within the default token budget.
Propose durable memories from the work we just finished.
Open the shared Talo hub and show all registered projects without loading their memory into this task.
